description: This file, serialization.h, declares templates and functions related to serialization and deserialization of storage objects in PyTorch, including raw file read/write operations and storage handling.

methods.name: doRead
methods.description: Template function to read data from a file descriptor into a buffer.

methods.name: doWrite
methods.description: Template function to write data from a buffer to a file descriptor.

methods.name: THPStorage_writeFileRaw
methods.description: Template function to write storage data to a raw file descriptor, with optional size saving.

methods.name: THPStorage_readFileRaw
methods.description: Function to read storage data from a raw file descriptor into a StorageImpl object.
